description:
Data Standardizer provides implementations of various internationally recognised standards in data processing, covering topics ranging from languages to currencies and geographical entities. With strongly-typed enumerations for each standard (where applicable) or other targeted data types, you can represent these elements in your code such that errors with invalid values are minimised.

Provides types supporting the reading and writing of files in standard formats.  Includes:
- Comma Separated Value (CSV).  Supports reading and writing CSV files with customizable delimiters. Ideal for CSV data normalization and transformation workflows.
releaseNotes:
- Add a netstandard2.1 target to DataStandardizer.File.CSV.
- Adds netstandard2.1 with nullable reference types enabled and no package dependencies beyond DataStandardizer.Core.
- Every target builds on its default language version, which is C# 8 for netstandard2.1. That needed three changes the mechanical edit did not cover.
- The netstandard1.3, netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0 assemblies disassemble identically before and after.
- Replace the CsvFileReader record tokenizer with a block-buffered single pass.
- ReadCsv and ParseCsvRecord read one character at a time, checked for the terminator on every character through a LINQ lambda, and copied each character five times on its way to a field value.
- They are replaced by an internal TryReadRecord(List<string>) that ReadLine calls directly.
- Parsing behaviour is unchanged, including the BadValueHandler calls and CsvFileException field indexes.
- The netstandard1.3 and netstandard2.0 builds take a System.Memory 4.5.5 dependency for the span APIs and ArrayPool.
- Read_Raw on net10.0 drops from 134 ms / 1,006 MB to 42 ms / 219 MB. The tokenizer on its own takes 8 ms / 22 MB. The rest is per-line work in ReadLine, which #135 covers.
- Refs.
- Cache property-to-field key resolution in CsvFileLineBase.
- GetPropertyKey now memoises the resolved field key per runtime line type and property name, so typed property access reflects once per process instead of on every get and set.
- Adds Model_IndexerGet/Model_IndexerSet benchmarks as the raw-indexer baseline for the typed property benchmarks.
- Build a per-reader field plan and drop reflection from the read path.
- ReadLine and MapCsvFieldsToProperties redid per-reader work on every line: sorting the mapper field names twice, merging them with the line's field names, finding each field's index with LINQ, and deserializing every field through MakeGenericMethod and MethodInfo.Invoke.
- The reader now builds a field plan once, and again only when a mapper is registered, unregistered or cleared.
- CsvFileIoBase calls the FromStringConverter with a direct cast and invokes VariableValueGenerator through a cached generic accessor, so neither uses MakeGenericMethod any more.
- Read_Mapped on net10.0 drops from 343.6 ms / 955.5 MB to 56.8 ms / 169.7 MB, and its overhead over Read_Raw from 300.6 ms to 33.0 ms (-89%).
- Build a per-writer field plan and write fields directly.
- WriteLine redid per-writer work on every line: resolving the mapper under the cache lock for unmapped record types, re-sorting the mapper field names, finding each field's mapping with FirstOrDefault, and building the line through a List, a LINQ Select, string.Join and a per-line delimiter string.
- The writer now builds a field plan once, and again only when the header line, the mapper cache version, the accumulated record line field names or (for an uncached mapper) the record line type changes.
- DoesFieldValueRequireQuoting handles Required with one span scan against a per-instance search set (SearchValues on net8.0+, a char[] elsewhere), confirming an EmbeddedLineBreak match only on a hit.
- Write_Raw allocation falls from 112.9 MB to 23 KB and Write_Mapped from 144.9 MB to 6.9 MB.
- Back the field bag with OrderedDictionary<string, object?> on .NET 9+.
- CsvFileLineBase stored fields in the non-generic OrderedDictionary, a Hashtable plus an ArrayList of boxed DictionaryEntry values.
- GetFieldValue reads with TryGetValue and SetFieldValue writes with a single indexer set.
- On the generic store, field names must be strings: Add, Insert and the key indexer setter throw ArgumentException for any other key type, while Contains, the key indexer getter and Remove treat it as missing, as the BCL generic dictionaries do through IDictionary.
- ICollection.CopyTo now copies DictionaryEntry items in field order on every target.
- Contract tests run each IOrderedDictionary member against both a CsvFileRecordLine and a non-generic OrderedDictionary as the reference.
- Size the buffers of internally created StreamReader and StreamWriter.
- The Stream and file-path constructors of CsvFileReader and CsvFileWriter now create their StreamReader/StreamWriter with a 16 KB buffer, and the file-path constructors open the FileStream explicitly with a matching buffer (and SequentialScan for reading).
- Adds file-backed FileReadBenchmarks and FileWriteBenchmarks.
